messages:
Devin: quick sync — we need a prioritization decision for the next sprint set: runtime change RFCs covering kernel routing, attention heuristics, and KV prefetch/eviction policies. customers are requesting lower p95 for chat and long-context tasks, but we also have cost & ops constraints. thoughts?

Maria: can you list tradeoffs you want to see? latency targets, expected cost delta, and rollout complexity would help.

Sachin: high level proposal: 
```
1) KV prefetch + smarter eviction (owner: Sachin) — high customer impact for chat workflows, expected p95 down 20-30% for typical sessions. low infra churn.
2) Attention fusion + block-sparse heuristics (owner: Devex/ML) — best for long-context models, medium risk to correctness, needs kernel vetting & regression tests.
3) Routing / kernel selector UI + gradual rollout infra (owner: Maria) — improves ops control, smaller perf delta but reduces blast radius for 1/2.
```

Elaine: flagged: Enterprise-X (legal) requires explicit fallback audit + deterministic behavior for quantized kernels. we need acceptance criteria for that or they'll block Dedicated deployments.

Devin: can we put concrete launch gates? e.g. p95, p99, accuracy/regression thresholds, rollback plan. sample gating ideas below: 
```
- p95 improvement >= 15% on canary workload OR cost per token delta <= +5%
- no regression >1% on quality eval set (prompt set A)
- automated rollback threshold: 5xx rate >0.5% or latency increase >20% vs baseline
- telemetry: per-model, per-route p50/p95/p99, tail src tracing, and kv hit-rate histogram
```

Sachin: agree. one edge-case: streaming + prefix-caching combos can mask kv-hit improvements in synthetic tests. propose we run a 2-week shadow run on a subset of production traffic before canary.

Maria: ops question — how much infra work for shadowing? is it just routing flag + metric tagging? ops-bot?

ops-bot: deploy plan stub: 
```
- feature-flag gated rollout
- shadow for 2w on 5% traffic with full tracing
- canary on 1 instance pool, 24h steady signal, then 25% for 48h
- full rollout by ROI gate and SRE signoff
```

Elaine: also add audit log requirement: every kernel switch must produce an immutable event (user id redacted) to satisfy Dedicated audit requirements. include KMS stamping for PKI.

Devin: ok summary and ask: prioritize 1) KV prefetch (Sachin) 2) Attn fusion (ML) 3) Routing/UI (Maria). acceptance criteria above. next step: Sachin please draft short PRD+RFC with ETA for shadow run + expected perf numbers. include testing matrix and rollback steps.

Sachin: will do. aiming for RFC draft by EOD Friday. will include test harness, perf baselines, and customer impact notes.

Maria: I'll scope the rollout infra task and pair with SRE for canary runbook.

Elaine: I'll circulate Dedicated compliance asks and a short checklist to append to the PRD.

Devin: perfect. if anyone thinks the order should change, reply in-thread before Thu EOD. otherwise I'll call this the working plan. :thumbsup:
